findings.text: _SCOPED_PLACEHOLDER redeclares the token that reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:332 owns as SCOPED_SUITE_PLACEHOLDER, and armed_argv at :253-260 re-resolves it rather than extending the owner's _scoped_suite_command at :370; the two now resolve the same declaration for the same purpose, so a change to the token in the owner would leave the landing measure handing the literal '{node_test_files}' to pytest while promotion's comparison still resolves it, with nothing reporting the split. Taking the constant from promotion_records, or giving the token one owner, removes the drift.

_ASSIGNMENT declares the shell-assignment pattern ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*= that reckon/crew/promotion_gate.py:243 already declares as _SHELL_ASSIGNMENT and reckon/hooks/worker_git_guard.py:127 as ASSIGNMENT_RE; the rule deciding what part of an armed command is environment rather than program now exists in three copies, so a widening of it in one place (quoting, a space after '=') leaves the others reading argv differently.

baseline_suite runs tests/test_the_landing_pass_measures_and_lands.py in the extracted base tree while after_suite runs tests/test_the_landing_measure_runs_the_armed_command.py in the worktree at head, so the recorded pair does not measure one suite and added_failure cannot be read from it as a like-for-like delta; the evidence survives because both arms report zero failures and the true importer pair, base-arm.log 16 passed at f1270e92 against head-importer.log 16 passed at 0c9c279fa3, supports the same conclusion, but the pair as recorded does not establish it and a reader deriving the delta from those two fields is comparing unlike runs.

justifications.durability: The gate is falsified by a real regression rather than observed green: negative-control.log restores 'environment, argv = {}, shlex.split(command)' in measure_run and the test fails with 'the base arm did not run' at tests/test_the_landing_measure_runs_the_armed_command.py:159, and the assertions at :155-157, :177-186 and :191-202 each name a distinct code change (no .venv link, no placeholder substitution, no environment peel, no carried test) that reddens them.
justifications.evidence: gate-head-absolute.log (revision 7f7021c83f, 1 passed, EXIT=0), base-arm.log (f1270e92, 16 passed, EXIT=0), head-importer.log (0c9c279fa3, 16 passed, EXIT=0) and negative-control.log (1 failed, EXIT=1) are on disk with their EXIT lines and support the four behaviours, but the plan's done-when also requires ruff check and ruff format --check on the changed paths and the manifest records neither; I ran both on the landed files (all checks passed; 2 files already formatted) and they pass, so the gap is in the record rather than the change.
justifications.fit: The additions follow the module's existing shape — a private compiled pattern beside _FAILED_ID at reckon/crew/landing_measure.py:58-66, a docstring stating the failure the code prevents, and an optional parameter defaulted so every existing caller is unchanged — and introduce no plan label, version suffix or ticket reference.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/landing_measure.py:405-470 measure_run now resolves the armed command once into environment plus argv, refuses a scoped command with no test file, links the base tree's environment and carries the node's new tests, so an armed command of the shape the plan recorded starts and measures instead of dying on 'PYTHONPATH=.'.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/landing_measure.py:62 _SCOPED_PLACEHOLDER and the substitution at :253-260 duplicate the placeholder token and its resolution that reckon/crew/promotion_records.py owns at :332 (SCOPED_SUITE_PLACEHOLDER) and :370 (_scoped_suite_command), and :66 _ASSIGNMENT duplicates promotion_gate.py:243, so the added definitions extend no owner even though the environment-peeling half of armed_argv has no existing owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in the delta is one of the three declared write paths and the evidence fragment carries only the landing record, while the scratch base tree and the gate logs live under the run directory and $TMPDIR rather than the repository.
